origin.description: Correct the Dickey-Fuller coefficient or its t ratio with a Bartlett long-run variance.
origin.usage: ur.pp(x, type = c("Z-alpha", "Z-tau"), model = c("constant", "trend"), lags = c("short", "long"), use.lag = NULL)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A numeric series. Missing values are dropped, and the first observation is the lag.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Z-tau corrects the t ratio. Z-alpha corrects n times the coefficient minus one, and then the critical values are missing.

arguments.name: model
arguments.text: constant fits an intercept. trend fits an intercept and a centered time index.

arguments.name: lags
arguments.text: short or long, with the same truncations as the KPSS lag. use.lag replaces that choice.

origin.details: The sample size in the correction is one less than the series, because the regression drops the first observation. The long-run variance adds Bartlett-weighted products of the residuals.
origin.value: The corrected statistic, the lag that was used, and the critical values when the type is Z-tau.
